description: From the Mandraki quay, two stone columns with a bronze stag and a doe mark the harbor mouth. Three medieval windmills stand along the mole, and the round Fort of Saint Nicholas with its lighthouse closes the view. The sky is clear, about 20.1°C, with wind near 18 km/h. Morning sun comes from the east. There is no Colossus across the entrance.
